title: PF4J API Reference
content: Source-linked Java API documentation for PF4J 3.15.0.

title: AbstractPluginManager
content: This class implements the boilerplate plugin code that any `PluginManager` implementation would have to support.

title: ResolveRecoveryStrategy
content: Strategy for handling the recovery of a plugin that could not be resolved (loaded) due to a dependency problem.

title: BasePluginLoader
content: Load all information needed by a plugin.

title: ClassLoadingStrategy
content: `ClassLoadingStrategy` will be used to configure `PluginClassLoader` loading order and contains all possible options supported by `PluginClassLoader` where: A = Application Source (load classes from parent classLoader) P = Plugin Source (load classes from this classloader) D = Dependencies (load classes from dependencies) @endiliteral

title: CompoundPluginLoader
content: A `PluginLoader` that delegates to a list of `PluginLoader`s.

title: CompoundPluginRepository
content: A `PluginRepository` that delegates to a list of `PluginRepository`s.

title: DefaultPluginLoader
content: Load all information needed by a plugin from `DefaultPluginClasspath`.

title: DependencyResolver
content: This class builds a dependency graph for a list of plugins (descriptors).

title: CyclicDependencyException
content: It will be thrown if a cyclic dependency is detected.

title: DependenciesNotFoundException
content: Indicates that the dependencies required were not found.

title: DependenciesWrongVersionException
content: Indicates that some dependencies have wrong version.

title: DevelopmentPluginClasspath
content: It's a compound `PluginClasspath` (`MAVEN` + `GRADLE` + `KOTLIN`) used in development mode (`RuntimeMode#DEVELOPMENT`).

title: DevelopmentPluginLoader
content: Load all information needed by a plugin from `DevelopmentPluginClasspath`.

title: Extension
content: An extension is a class that extends an extension point.

title: ExtensionFinder
content: Provides the functionality for finding extensions.

title: ExtensionPoint
content: An extension point is a formal declaration in a plugin (or in application API) where customization is allowed.

title: IndexedExtensionFinder
content: All extensions declared in a plugin are indexed in a file META-INF/extensions.idx.

title: InvalidPluginDescriptorException
content: This exception signals incomplete or wrong information in the descriptor for a plugin.

title: JarPluginManager
content: It's a `PluginManager` that loads each plugin from a jar file.

title: LegacyExtensionFinder
content: All extensions declared in a plugin are indexed in a file META-INF/extensions.idx.

title: LoggingPluginStateListener
content: It's an implementation of `PluginStateListener` that writes all events to logger (DEBUG level).

title: ManifestPluginDescriptorFinder
content: Read the plugin descriptor from the manifest file.

title: Plugin
content: This class will be extended by all plugins and serve as the common class between a plugin and the application.

title: PluginAlreadyLoadedException
content: Thrown when a plugin is already loaded.

title: PluginClassLoader
content: One instance of this class should be created for every available plug-in.

title: PluginDependency
content: A plugin dependency is a dependency that the plugin has on another plugin.

title: PluginDescriptor
content: A plugin descriptor contains information about a plug-in.

title: PluginDescriptorFinder
content: Find a plugin descriptor for a plugin path.

title: PluginFactory
content: It's responsible for creating a plugin instance.

title: PluginLoader
content: Load all information (classes) needed by a plugin.

title: PluginManager
content: Provides the functionality for plugin management such as load, start and stop the plugins.

title: PluginNotFoundException
content: Thrown when a plugin is not found.

title: PluginRuntimeException
content: An exception used to indicate that a plugin problem occurred.

title: PluginStateEvent
content: Event object that indicates a change in the state of a plugin.

title: PluginStateListener
content: Defines the interface for an object that listens to plugin state changes.

title: PluginStatusProvider
content: Provides a way to check if a plugin is disabled and to disable/enable a plugin.

title: PropertiesPluginDescriptorFinder
content: Find a plugin descriptor in a properties file (in plugin repository).

title: RuntimeMode
content: The runtime mode of the PF4J application.

title: SecurePluginManagerWrapper
content: Use this class to wrap the original plugin manager to prevent full access from within plugins.

title: SingletonExtensionFactory
content: An `ExtensionFactory` that always returns a specific instance.

title: VersionManager
content: Manager responsible for versions of plugins.

title: ZipPluginManager
content: It's a `PluginManager` that loads each plugin from a zip file.

title: ExtensionInfo
content: This class holds the parameters of an `org.pf4j.Extension` annotation defined for a certain class.

title: ExtensionVisitor
content: This visitor extracts an `ExtensionInfo` from any class, that holds an `Extension` annotation.

title: AndFileFilter
content: This filter providing conditional AND logic across a list of file filters.

title: DirectoryFileFilter
content: Filter accepts files that are directories.

title: ExtensionFileFilter
content: Filter accepts any file ending in extension.

title: HiddenFilter
content: Filter that only accepts hidden files.

title: JarFileFilter
content: File filter that accepts all files ending with .JAR.

title: NameFileFilter
content: Filter accepts any file with this name.

title: NotFileFilter
content: This filter produces a logical NOT of the filters specified.

title: OrFileFilter
content: This filter providing conditional OR logic across a list of file filters.

title: Unzip
content: This class extracts the content of the plugin zip into a directory.

title: ZipFileFilter
content: File filter that accepts all files ending with .ZIP.
